scope: Real app.js executed in node:vm with a small fake DOM and deferred fetch; JavaScript state/unit regression only.

commands.expected_result: The two regression checks fail on the exact preserved original script.

limitations: No browser rendering, native modal/focus behavior, PDF viewer, accessibility or real HTTP transport was tested.
Outstanding fetches are invalidated for display but are not cancelled at the network layer.
Cancelling a dialog cannot undo a mutation already sent; its stale completion no longer changes the current UI.

peer_review.finding: A delayed metadata response could outlive a case summary revision/status advance.
peer_review.resolution: Remember pending document revision/status; a changed current case summary starts one replacement request and fences the old response.

prior_development_evidence: verification.json and fixed-regression.log retain the earlier 21-case run before the peer finding.
